categoryThesis: isteBul owns the Decision Platform category in Turkey (then EU/GCC): neutral, deterministic purchase decisions above listings, OTAs, and single-product fintech — not another marketplace.

categoryDefinition.name: Decision Platform
categoryDefinition.ownershipSignal: When users say 'karar için isteBul' before opening Sahibinden or a bank site

competitorLandscape.name: Sahibinden
competitorLandscape.isteBulCounter: Decision + TCO + finance fit — 'search there, decide here'
competitorLandscape.winCondition: Qualified lead + completion rate beats raw listing CTR
competitorLandscape.coexistStrategy: Affiliate/embed CTAs; SEO hub captures consideration queries

competitorLandscape.name: Arabam
competitorLandscape.isteBulCounter: Total cost of ownership + scoring + partner dispatch
competitorLandscape.winCondition: Users complete wizard before browsing 20 listings
competitorLandscape.coexistStrategy: Comparison landing 'Arabam vs isteBul' — methodology SEO

competitorLandscape.name: Marketplaces (Hepsiemlak, Booking, Trendyol-style)
competitorLandscape.isteBulCounter: High-consideration decision layer — budget, finance, risk before transaction
competitorLandscape.winCondition: Own 'how much / how to pay' before they own 'where to book/buy'
competitorLandscape.coexistStrategy: No inventory build; deep links + Pro retention on decision history

competitorLandscape.name: Fintech comparison (bank rate sites, KOBİ kredi)
competitorLandscape.theirMoat: Bank partnerships + SEO on rate keywords
competitorLandscape.isteBulCounter: Asset-context financing (vehicle price → payment load → offer fit)
competitorLandscape.winCondition: Lead includes vehicle + score + partner route, not form-only
competitorLandscape.coexistStrategy: finance_offers truth layer; neutral rank in Auto funnel

competitorLandscape.name: Generic AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, copilots)
competitorLandscape.isteBulCounter: Deterministic scores; LLM cannot change price/score; CRM + dispatch closure
competitorLandscape.winCondition: Repeat sessions with saved decisions + partner outcomes
competitorLandscape.coexistStrategy: Anti-hallucination narrative; export PDF Pro; methodology E-E-A-T

competitorLandscape.name: Niche decision tools (Edmunds-style, car configurators, credit simulators)
competitorLandscape.wedge: Deep single-use calculator or US/EU data
competitorLandscape.isteBulCounter: Unified consultant + partner economics across TR verticals
competitorLandscape.winCondition: Cross-vertical habit (auto → finance → insurance) on one account
competitorLandscape.coexistStrategy: Benchmark UX; localize TR cost truth; registry for 8 verticals
